# noust_servers (Data Source)

The servers the Noust the provider talks to manages: itself, and, on a central, the servers enrolled in its fleet, with whether each answers and which version it runs. Needs the permission `fleet.read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "noust_servers" "all" {}

output "unreachable" {
  value = [for server in data.noust_servers.all.servers : server.name if server.reachability != "reachable"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) A constant, for Terraform.
- `servers` (Attributes List) The servers, as the fleet view lists them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--servers))

<a id="nestedatt--servers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `servers`

Read-Only:

- `labels` (Map of String) Its labels.
- `local` (Boolean) Whether it is the server the provider talks to.
- `name` (String) The server's name in the fleet.
- `reachability` (String) reachable, unreachable or unknown.
- `version` (String) The Noust version it runs.
